title: RPG Maker MV is not launching

posts.author: Drogazy
posts.body:
I've been using mv for a couple of years, and recently it stopped working. The other RPG Maker series works fine. I've tried a lot of things: clean cache,
Installed Files, and check integrity.
Nothing worked. I don't know what it might be. Can someone help?

Does it appear that the "game" is launched even though it is not? Or that Steam is closing it but it never finishes doing so? if so then try searching "game" on task manager, and killing the process, happened to me a few times that when i tested a battle/the game, that window didn't close fully.
Or you could also try searching for Rpgmaker there too, and kill the process.
Have you tried uninstalling it and reinstalling it back? Restarting your computer maybe?
